summary: Intercont (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing the October 11, 2026 resignation of Ms. Qingyuan Wang as Chief Financial Officer and director, effective immediately, and the Board's appointment of Ms. Muchun Zhu as Interim CFO effective October 16, 2026. Ms. Zhu retains her roles as CEO, director, and Chairman, concentrating executive authority in one person. No terms, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed. The abrupt, immediate-effect departure with an internal, concurrent interim appointment leaves the CFO seat unfilled on a permanent basis; watch for subsequent 6-K disclosure on a permanent CFO search and any related governance or controls implications.
